none: PAS NLM-288D18: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian from Keelby
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN VAL[---] ; R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Securitas Rei Publicae issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped, diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: DN VAL[---]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left holding wreath; three characters left of figure: *RO [reading top to bottom]. Reverse inscription: SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. Diameter: 17.5mm, Weight: 2.52gms, die axis: 12
